data_fields.name: crouch_rate
data_fields.donor_constant: 10 per second (crouchPerc += dt * 10, on ground only)

data_fields.name: landing_bounce_factor
data_fields.donor_constant: 2.0 (eye z velocity doubled on vertical collision)

data_fields.name: mouse_rate
data_fields.donor_constant: 0.0089 (rotation per unit of averaged mouse delta)

best_idea: A follow point driven by an exact closed-form damped spring, stepped by the real frame delta, with a velocity kick on step-up and on landing, so curbs and ledges move the camera smoothly without a fixed-step loop.
decision_why: The donor camera is a first-person eye, so its shape transfers but its framing does not. The exact-step spring and step-up/landing kicks suit a third-person follow point and remove curb and landing jitter; shoulder offset, wall pull-in, lock-on framing and combat FOV are not in this code and must be designed for Frankendom. The numbers are client tuning, not zone data.
acceptance: A client unit test asserts that one step of 1/30 s equals two steps of 1/60 s within 1e-9, and that a 0.1 m vertical offset with no kick returns to within 1 mm of rest in about 0.35 s; aim rays stay on the unsprung pivot.
